name: Sikka
roleNotes: Captive marine terminal of the Reliance Jamnagar complex, the world's largest refinery site: single-point moorings off Sikka receive crude that has crossed the Arabian Sea from the Gulf, and the product jetties ship diesel, gasoline and jet to Europe, Asia and Africa.

wikipedia.title: Jamnagar refinery
wikipedia.extract: The Jamnagar refinery, also known as RIL Jamnagar or RPL Jamnagar, is a private sector crude oil refinery owned by Reliance Industries in Motikhavdi, Jamnagar, Gujarat, India. The refinery was commissioned in July 1999 with an initial installed capacity of 668,000 barrels per day (106,200 m3/d). Its current installed capacity after expansion is 1,240,000 barrels per day (197,000 m3/d). It is currently the largest oil refinery in the world.
